data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004's efficiency trade-off integrates with SRC_005's epistemic tariff to produce a compound mechanism: suppression occurs only when the tariff cost (excluded rival primitives) exceeds the efficiency savings (avoided re-derivation), making suppression a threshold phenomenon rather than a systematic outcome. The integration depends on both: SRC_004 supplies the efficiency credit, SRC_005 supplies the epistemic debit, and net suppression = debit − credit. This is refuted if the efficiency savings and epistemic losses are not commensurable (cannot be compared on a common scale), because then no threshold exists and the two mechanisms operate independently rather than integrating into a compound trade-off.
